remarks: Welcome to Upper Minivale - a haven where charm and comfort meet in Springdale's most desirable neighborhood. Tucked near a quiet cul-de-sac, this beautifully appointed, move-in ready gem of a home invites you to settle in and stay. Step into the warm embrace of the living room, where a cozy wood-burning fireplace sets the tone. The open dining area flows seamlessly into a sunlit kitchen adorned with cathedral ceilings, exposed beams, and generous counter space, perfect for hosting and heartwarming meals. A convenient first-floor bedroom and updated full bath offer ideal accommodations for guests or in-laws. Utilize the convenient Mudroom with side entrance and 2 car garage with full loft storage. Upstairs, retreat to the serene primary bedroom with walk-in closets and spa-like bath with twin sinks and a soaking tub. The spacious third bedroom with its own walk-in closet completes the second level. Gleaming hardwood floors throughout 1st and 2nd floor. Downstairs, the expansive lower level offers endless potential-create an accessory dwelling unit (ADU) or a retreat with a family room, bedroom, office nook, half bath (with room for a shower), and walkout to a private patio. Outside, enjoy half an acre of professionally landscaped beauty with fresh sod, irrigation, stone walls, and a tree-lined border. Just a stroll to Sterling Farms Golf Course and minutes from top schools, parks, Springdale Metro North Station & the Merritt. This is more than a home - it's a lifestyle.
